l1: Is the customer using 'Reset this PC' from Settings, from WinRE, or a remote reset triggered via Intune/MDM?
Did they choose 'Keep my files' or 'Remove everything'?
At what stage does the reset fail or hang — preparing, resetting, or the post-reset OOBE?
Is this a physical device or a cloud-managed device using Cloud PC/Autopilot Reset?
Has the user already backed up any files they care about, in case 'Remove everything' is the only viable path forward?
l2: Is the recovery image being used the factory-embedded WinRE image, or a custom/replaced recovery image?
Is BitLocker enabled on the OS drive, and if so, has the recovery key been confirmed available before reset?
For an Intune-triggered remote reset, did the 'Wipe' or 'Fresh Start' action specify 'Keep enrollment state' correctly for this scenario?
Is there a factory recovery partition present and healthy (check with 'reagentc /info')?

l1: Run 'reagentc /info' to confirm the Windows Recovery Environment status and the recovery image location.
Check %windir%\Logs\CBS\CBS.log and %windir%\Panther\ setup logs for reset-specific failures.
Check available free disk space — a reset needs enough free space to stage the new image alongside existing data if 'Keep my files' is selected.
Confirm whether the failure is reproducible from WinRE directly (bypassing Settings) to rule out an OS-level trigger issue.
l2: If the recovery image is missing or corrupted, run 'reagentc /enable' after re-pointing to a valid WinRE.wim via 'reagentc /setreimage'.
Check setupact.log/setuperr.log under $Windows.~BT\Sources\Panther (created during reset, similar to an in-place upgrade) for the specific failing phase.
For a BitLocker-protected drive, confirm whether reset is failing because the drive couldn't be unlocked automatically — check TPM/protector status.
For Autopilot Reset / cloud-managed scenarios, check the Intune device action status and correlate with MDM diagnostic logs (mdmdiagnosticstool.exe) on the device.

l1: Free up disk space and retry the reset.
Retry the reset directly from WinRE (Advanced Startup) if the Settings-triggered reset fails to start.
Suspend BitLocker before attempting the reset if a protector-related failure is suspected.
Confirm the correct 'Keep my files' vs 'Remove everything' choice matches what the user actually intended, since the wrong choice can look like a 'failure' to the user.
If 'Cloud download' fails, retry with 'Local reinstall' instead (or vice versa) as a quick first troubleshooting step.
Confirm the device has a stable internet connection before attempting a Cloud download reset, since it re-downloads the OS image.
l2: If 'reagentc /info' shows the recovery environment as disabled or the image path is invalid, re-point it with 'reagentc /setreimage /path <driveletter>\Recovery\WindowsRE' then 'reagentc /enable'.

If reset fails partway through (similar to an in-place upgrade rollback), treat setupact.log/setuperr.log under Panther the same way as a Windows Upgrade failure — check for a driver or component blocking progress.
For remote/Autopilot Reset failures, confirm the device successfully checked in and collect mdmdiagnosticstool.exe output to see the exact stage the wipe command failed at.
As a last resort when the recovery partition itself is corrupted, perform a clean reinstall from bootable media rather than continuing to retry the built-in reset.

l1: Record whether 'Keep my files' or 'Remove everything' was selected.
Note the exact stage and any error code/message shown during the reset.
Confirm whether this was triggered locally, from WinRE, or remotely via Intune/MDM.
Note whether BitLocker is enabled on the OS drive.
l2: Collect 'reagentc /info' output showing WinRE status and image path.
Collect setupact.log/setuperr.log from $Windows.~BT\Sources\Panther generated during the reset attempt.
For remote resets, collect the Intune device action history and an mdmdiagnosticstool.exe cab from the device.
Confirm and record the recovery partition's health/size from 'reagentc /info' and diskpart's partition list.

reset_fails_to_start_recovery_environmen.title: Reset this PC fails to start — recovery environment is disabled or broken

steps.expect: Shows Windows RE status as Disabled, or an invalid/missing image path

steps.action: Check whether the recovery partition still exists and has sufficient free space via diskpart
steps.expect: Confirms whether the partition itself is missing/too small or just misconfigured

steps.action: Re-point the recovery image with 'reagentc /setreimage /path <path>\Recovery\WindowsRE' and then run 'reagentc /enable'
steps.expect: Reagentc /info now reports Windows RE status: Enabled

remote_autopilot_reset_stuck.title: Remote Autopilot Reset / Intune Wipe action stuck or not completing

steps.action: Check the device action status in the Intune portal for the Wipe/Fresh Start command
steps.expect: Shows Pending, Failed, or no recent check-in from the device

steps.action: Collect an MDM diagnostics cab via mdmdiagnosticstool.exe from the device if it's still reachable
steps.expect: Identifies whether the device ever received the command or failed locally during execution

steps.action: If the device never received the command, force a sync from Settings > Access work or school, or reissue the action from Intune
steps.expect: Device check-in shows the command received

steps.action: If it failed locally (e.g. recovery environment broken), remediate that first (see the recovery-environment playbook) before reissuing the reset
Confirm the device completes OOBE and re-enrolls per the Autopilot profile
steps.expect: Device returns to a fresh, enrolled state as expected

reset_stuck_at_percentage.title: Reset this PC progress appears stuck at a fixed percentage

steps.action: Confirm the percentage hasn't moved for a reasonable window (30–60+ minutes) given the reset type
steps.expect: Confirms a genuine stall rather than a slow but progressing reset

steps.action: Check setupact.log/setuperr.log under $Windows.~BT\Sources\Panther generated by the reset for the last logged operation
steps.expect: Identifies the specific stage where progress stopped

steps.action: If truly hung, force a restart and let it attempt automatic recovery; if it fails, retry with the other reset method (Cloud download vs Local reinstall)
steps.expect: Device recovers or the alternate reset method completes successfully

steps.action: Confirm the device reaches OOBE successfully
steps.expect: Reset completes and device boots to a fresh setup experience

cloud_download_reset_fails_network.title: Cloud download reset fails due to network/connectivity issues

steps.action: Confirm the device had network access at the time Cloud download was selected
steps.expect: Confirms connectivity as the likely cause

steps.action: Check whether the failure occurred during the initial download or partway through applying the downloaded image
steps.expect: Identifies whether it's purely a download failure or a subsequent apply failure

steps.action: Ensure a stable wired or strong Wi-Fi connection is available, then retry Cloud download, or switch to Local reinstall if network access can't be guaranteed
steps.expect: Reset proceeds without a connectivity interruption
